fieldValues.title: The clerk
fieldValues.purpose: The programme's internal decision-making machinery: the code, wire formats, briefs and deployments that put the handbook's practices to work for people and agents.
fieldValues.inside: the-greenman/clerk: lib/, bin/, scripts/, routines/, .claude/commands/, its workflows, and the pins that deploy them into a programme repo.
fieldValues.outside: Programme data and settings (srs-programme records); what the products do (SRS standard, SRS implementation); who may change the clerk's authority rules (gates, merge rules, quorum, budget, pause, the authority signal): the owner keeps those (a8bc55ef).
fieldValues.authority_basis: Programme coordination (346e323e, affirmed); a8bc55ef and 926c059f (ratified 2026-10-20). Held by the central group until a group for Programme coordination is chartered.
fieldValues.revision_condition: When the group for Programme coordination is chartered, or when a layer below cannot be stated without crossing into another.
